source_facts: An Index adjustment may be necessary between two regular Rebalance Days.
An adjustment is required if a corporate action occurs in relation to an Index Component.
An adjustment may affect an Index Component, the number of Index Components, or the weighting of certain Index Components.
The adjustment will comply with the Solactive Equity Index Methodology.
Solactive will announce the Index adjustment on the Solactive website under Announcements.
Solactive will give at least two Trading Days' notice for the affected Index Component.
The Index adjustment will be implemented on the effective day specified in the notice.
render_facts: Adjustments to the Index may be necessary in certain circumstances between regular rebalance days.
Any such adjustment is made in compliance with the Solactive Equity Index Methodology and is announced by Solactive in the Announcements section of the Solactive Website.

A corporate action specified in Section 4.4 that relates to an Index Component gives rise to a required Index Adjustment for the Index, affecting that component and falling within a Rebalance Interval.
The effect of a required adjustment may relate to the component relation, component number, or component weighting, and the weighting effect is described with respect to certain Index Components.
The relevant notice states the effective day for the adjustment.
The adjustment is implemented on that effective day.
The notice is published by Solactive on the Solactive Website in the Announcements section and provides a notice period of at least two Trading Days for the affected component.

render_only_facts.fact: The relevant notice states the effective day for the adjustment.
